about: A quick, hand-gathered starting point for the leaderboard (core/src/leaderboard.rs), to be replaced wholesale by a proper source later. quality is the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (0-100; the best model scored 57-65 when read); ttft_ms is time to first token in milliseconds, which for Artificial Analysis includes reasoning time; tps is output tokens per second. Local speeds are community MLX runs and vary a lot by Mac. A figure that was not found is left out, never guessed; each has its source. aliases are other ids the same model goes by.
